# OpenAI vs Allternit: Comprehensive 1-to-1 Gap Analysis

**Source:** OpenAI Developers + ChatGPT/Codex docs crawled and catalogued.
**Total OpenAI capabilities mapped:** 4853
- ✅ Present in Allternit: 269
- ⚠️ Partial match: 2498
- ❌ Gap (missing): 1533
- ➖ Not applicable: 553

## Method

1. Crawled OpenAI docs (`developers.openai.com` + `learn.chatgpt.com`) and extracted every page and heading.
2. Ran a Kimi k3 agent audit against the Allternit codebase to identify platform/service-level equivalents and gaps.
3. Mapped each OpenAI feature heading to the nearest Kimi finding. Unmatched headings received a conservative category heuristic.
4. Listed every gap and partial below, grouped by OpenAI product area.

❌ **Does Codex Security auto-apply patches?**
   - OpenAI page: [Codex Security cloud FAQ](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/security/faq.md)
   - Description: No. The proposed patch is a recommended remediation. Users can review it and push it as a PR to GitHub from the findings UI, but Codex Security does not auto-apply changes to the repository.
   - Notes: Specific ChatGPT/Codex surface feature not found in Allternit.

❌ **Does it replace SAST?**
   - OpenAI page: [Codex Security cloud FAQ](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/security/faq.md)
   - Description: No. Codex Security complements SAST. It adds semantic, LLM-based reasoning and automated validation, while existing SAST tools still provide broad deterministic coverage.
   - Notes: Specific ChatGPT/Codex surface feature not found in Allternit.

❌ **Does it replace manual security review?**
   - OpenAI page: [Codex Security cloud FAQ](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/security/faq.md)
   - Description: No. Codex Security accelerates review and helps rank findings, but it does not replace code-level validation, exploitability checks, or human threat assessment.
   - Notes: Specific ChatGPT/Codex surface feature not found in Allternit.

❌ **Does the patch directly modify my PR branch?**
   - OpenAI page: [Codex Security cloud FAQ](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/security/faq.md)
   - Description: No. The workflow generates a diff, patch file, or suggested change for maintainers and reviewers to inspect before applying.
   - Notes: Specific ChatGPT/Codex surface feature not found in Allternit.

❌ **Does the project need to be built for scanning?**
   - OpenAI page: [Codex Security cloud FAQ](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/security/faq.md)
   - Description: No. Codex Security can produce findings from repository and commit context without a compile step. During auto-validation, it may try to build the project inside the container if that helps reproduce 
   - Notes: Specific ChatGPT/Codex surface feature not found in Allternit.

   - Notes: Workspace-agent trigger/inspect surface partially implemented.

⚠️ **Response**
   - OpenAI page: [Trigger workspace agent runs](https://developers.openai.com/workspace-agents/trigger-runs.md)
   - Description: The API durably queues the trigger event and returns 202 Accepted with a link to the ChatGPT conversation:  json {   "conversationurl": "https://chatgpt.
   - Allternit equivalent: Replies runtime (POST /v1/replies, SSE run events) + OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions gateway
   - Evidence: api/services/replies-runtime/src/replies.router.ts:4-8, api/services/replies-runtime/src/index.ts:32, cmd/allternit-api/src/llm_gateway/proxy.rs:6
   - Notes: Stateful reply/run model with SSE exists, but no full Responses API surface (input items CRUD, encrypted reasoning items, hosted tool outputs). Gateway translates OpenAI chat-completions shape onto the internal Gizzi bus.

⚠️ **What this token can access**
   - OpenAI page: [Authenticate with Workspace Agent access tokens](https://developers.openai.com/workspace-agents/authentication.md)
   - Description: Workspace Agent access tokens are scoped to Workspace Agents API operations only.
   - Notes: Workspace-agent trigger/inspect surface partially implemented.
